en: What tiny thing made Allah very, very happy?
A man was walking along a path.
He saw a prickly branch, lying right in the way.
So he picked it up, and moved it out of the way.
And Allah was happy with what he did, and He forgave him!
So if you see a stone on the path, or a toy on the stairs, move it away!
What will you move out of the way today?
